title: Secure Admin, Gallery and Invoicing

assessment_snapshot.intro: The repository is a static resort website with an existing visual theme and no detected application backend, database, authentication, or API. The requested admin workflow therefore needs a secure persistence and hosting decision as well as UI behavior details.
bullets: 17 HTML pages with shared CSS and JavaScript; the public site currently uses a static-file pattern
No detected API/server, database, login flow, or upload service
Requested: password-protected admin access, gallery image management, bill upload and branded invoice generation, and a resort-logo browser tab icon
Existing visual design tokens and responsive styling are in css/style.css; the current public site should remain available

proposed_outcome: Add a discreet admin entry point and a secure authenticated dashboard without compromising the public site. Enable persistent gallery image management and an agreed bill-to-invoice workflow that produces downloadable, on-brand invoices. Add the resort logo as the browser favicon. Confirm the backend, storage, invoice behavior, and access policy before implementation.
